title: Album release: Anthology 4 | 2025
content:
The Beatles’ Anthology 4 was released on 21 November 2025, as was the box set Anthology Collection.

Anthology 4 contains 13 previously-unreleased recordings – versions of ‘Tell Me Why’, ‘If I Fell’, ‘Matchbox’, ‘Every Little Thing’, ‘I Need You’, ‘I’ve Just Seen A Face’, ‘In My Life’, ‘Nowhere Man’, ‘Baby, You’re A Rich Man’, ‘All You Need Is Love’, ‘The Fool On The Hill’, ‘I Am The Walrus’, and ‘Hey Bulldog’. There were also remixes of the 1990s reunion songs ‘Free As A Bird’ and ‘Real Love’.

Anthology Collection contains all four Anthology albums, including remasters of Anthology 1 (1995), Anthology 2 (1996), and Anthology 3 (1996) by Giles Martin.

The releases come just days before the release of the Anthology documentary on Disney+. The eight-part TV series has been restored and expanded with a new ninth episode, and will stream from 26 November 2025. The new episode will contain previously-unseen behind-the-scenes footage of Paul McCartney, George Harrison, and Ringo Starr coming together in 1994 and 1995 to work on Anthology and reflecting on their shared life as The Beatles.
